description: Reopen r-sort-3b-mix (General) read-only. On MY, table-type Seek reading NoMatch and the current ID after each: IX_KV with (K, V1) for every key combination under = >= > <= < and with the K-only key under the same five operators; IX_VK with (V1, K) for every combination and with the V1-only key under = and >=; IX_KdVd with (K, V1) for every combination under =, >= and <=. K is a, A, b, e-acute or Null and V1 is a Byte value or Null. Asks which row each full or partial compound key selects on ascending, descending and mixed-direction indexes, including Null components, case-tied text and Byte boundaries.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
